productUrl.title: Product Website URL
productUrl.description: Your product's website address, e.g. https://your-product.com (not the product name). This is the only required field: the Actor reads your site to learn what you sell and which competitors to watch.

productName.title: Product Name (optional)
productName.description: Leave blank to use the name from your website. Your own brand is always excluded from the results.

productDescription.title: Product Description (optional)
productDescription.description: Optional extra context: what you sell, pricing, and key advantages. Needed only if your website can't be read.
productDescription.example: Flat $15/mo invoicing for freelancers and small agencies. Unlimited clients, automated overdue payment reminders, 0% markup on Stripe/Wise/UPI, 1-click FreshBooks/QuickBooks CSV import.

competitors.title: Known Competitors (Optional)
competitors.description: Leave blank to auto-discover top 4-6 competitors automatically.

sources.title: Complaint Sources
sources.description: Select platforms to harvest. Default Lean mode excludes G2 for fast ~40s runs.

lookbackDays.title: Lookback Window (Days)
lookbackDays.description: Only harvest complaints published within the last N days.

minWinabilityScore.title: Minimum Hot-Lead Score (0-100)
minWinabilityScore.description: Complaints scoring at or above this threshold receive dual outreach drafts.

tone.title: Outreach Tone
tone.description: Voice for the drafted replies: peer-engineer technical, candid founder, or concise executive.

dealValueUsd.title: Deal value per customer (USD, optional)
dealValueUsd.description: What one new customer pays you per billing period. Used only for the illustrative revenue calculator in the report; leave blank to enter it there.
dealValueUsd.sectionDescription: Illustrative scenario only, based on your own assumptions. It is not a forecast.

billingPeriod.title: Billing period
billingPeriod.description: How the deal value is billed.

contractMonths.title: Assumed contract length (months)
contractMonths.description: How long a converted customer stays, for monthly or yearly billing.

assumedConversionRatePercent.title: Assumed conversion rate (%)
assumedConversionRatePercent.description: Your guess at the share of Act-now opportunities that become customers.

modelName.title: AI Model
modelName.description: OpenRouter model id used through the Apify OpenRouter proxy. LLM usage is billed to your Apify account; no separate AI key is needed.

llmApiKey.title: Optional BYOK Gemini API Key (fallback)
llmApiKey.description: Optional: your own Google AI Studio key, used only if the Apify OpenRouter proxy fails.
